proposed_capability: Require a per-Sim Fame goal and matching current same-instance evidence before a native drone effect; allow exact recovery without starving ordinary native policy.
player_save_control_impact: Reuse game-native paired idle probes, protected save admission, actor ownership, and atomic dispatch. Vision and EA files can inform discovery only. No off-lot screen input or new game loop.
expected_outcome: Automatic proposals preserve the observed scope, selected goal and known native drone evidence. Protect existing recovery, perks, unrelated normal native actions and handoff.
negative_tests: No-goal drone cannot be stopped or stowed autonomously.
Conflicting object/owner/location/mode under the same capture cannot authorize an effect.
Interrupted or unavailable native evidence preserves observations and rejects replay.
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature PR or omit the optional Fairy Dust support from the independently built installed ecology package.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build runtime object, actor/zone and affordance IDs and gameplay trial under issue #171.
